title: Scrolling Instability in PyCharm Terminal During Long Conversations
body:
**Bug Description**
Sometimes you get crazy scrolling back in the conversion to the top (for like 2s and then back to normal) You can trigger with this a long conversation and the the / command. (pycharm professional 2024.3.3 default terminal)

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: xterm-256color 
- Version: 0.2.27
- Feedback ID: 98dc8b13-8a44-47d5-ba78-ba7cc25263b9
author: b-burton
